why.headline: Why have a website of your own?

reasons.title: Every channel leads somewhere
reasons.description: Google, Instagram, WhatsApp, reviews, AI agents, referrals, email. Each one brings someone looking for you. The question is: where do they land?

reasons.title: A profile is rented. A site is yours.
reasons.description: Instagram and WhatsApp follow another company's rules, which can change tomorrow. Your site is the only address you own, telling your story your way.

reasons.title: The site is what converts
reasons.description: Every channel brings people to the site. The site is what turns them into customers: it shows what you do, answers questions and leads to contact.

why.diagramLabel: Diagram: the site at the center, connected to Google, Instagram, WhatsApp, reviews, AI agents, referrals and email.

items.question: Why have a website of your own?
What's included in every package?
items.answer: Every site ships responsive, with SEO, AEO, GEO and optimized performance, and is published with domain and HTTPS configured. After launch, hosting and maintenance are covered by the monthly package.

items.question: What is the monthly maintenance package?
items.answer: It's what keeps your site online and working after launch: hosting plus fixes for bugs and one-off problems. If something stops working, I fix it. New development, such as pages, features or layout changes, is not part of the package and is quoted separately. It costs R$ 35/month for landing pages and R$ 45/month for business websites. For web apps, it is defined together with the scope.

items.question: Is the domain included?
items.answer: Domain and HTTPS setup, yes. Buying and renewing the domain are not included in the price, but if you prefer, I can buy and set it up for you, as long as you cover the cost of the domain.

items.question: How long until the site is ready?
items.answer: A landing page takes 1 to 2 weeks, and a business website 2 to 3 weeks. For web apps and systems, the timeline is set after scoping. In every case, it comes in writing in the proposal.

items.question: Can the price change mid-project?
items.answer: Not without you knowing. Scope, deadline and price are fixed in writing before a single line of code. If the project needs to change, we talk first.

items.question: What are SEO, AEO and GEO?
items.answer: SEO is what gets your site found on Google. AEO prepares your content for direct answers and voice search. GEO makes your site easy for AIs like ChatGPT and Gemini to understand and cite.

items.question: Can I add a blog, CRM or conversion tracking later?
items.answer: Yes. Add-on services work with any package, now or after the site is live, and are quoted separately.

items.question: Who will build my site?
items.answer: Me, directly. I'm a senior software engineer with over 15 years of experience, and I handle the project from the first chat to the live site, with no agency in between.
